title: Attahaasa
desc: Veerappan, a poacher, chooses the path of crime and becomes a dangerous criminal. He systematically kills all the policemen who try to stop his evil ways and nab him.

title: Nagadevathe
desc: Naganna, a worshipper of the snake goddess, vows celibacy in her honour, but is seduced by a dancer. When he dies from a snake bite, his brother starts to despise the deity.

title: Rakshasa
desc: A police officer is willing to cross any line to bring criminals from the underworld to justice and rid society of its evils.
Six friends plan a trek to an untrodden mountain in the Western Ghats only to end up experiencing strange and unusual incidents that put their lives at risk.

title: Cobra
desc: A genius mathematician uses his skills to assassinate his targets and stay clear of law enforcement. However, a vigilante secretly tracks his movements, vying for revenge.
